name: task-card
title: Task card
description: One task in a list: id, status and priority pills, up to 2 quiet #tags with "+n", title, 2-line description, owner footer with due date and comments.

provenance.note: "nice in general. like proportions. i think tags are too much and layout might be fixed a bit"
"exactly what i needed! Just would move optional at most 2 tags to the row next to status and priority and add like +2 if there is more."
"quiet tags yet all pills should have the same size i belive?" Applied: status and priority pills share one 20px height, 8px side padding and a 12px leading mark.

rules: Status row: id, status pill, priority pill, then at most 2 tags and "+n" for the rest (round-003, round-005).
Tags are quiet muted #text, never badges (round-001, round-005).
All pills in the status row share one height and one padding (round-005).
Keep the round-001 C proportions: title, 2-line description, owner footer (round-001, round-003).
Status color is a dot inside the pill; the label carries the meaning (round-005, round-006).

controls.label: Title on every card (try a long one)
